name: MemoryBank / SiliconFriend
ontology_notes: JSON memory bank keyed by user name with history (dated multi-turn dialogs), daily summary, daily personality, overall_history, overall_personality. Retrieval units are conversation turns and event summaries as FAISS Documents. No character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or OOC types. SiliconFriend is one AI companion persona tuned on 38k psychological dialogs.

ontology.evidence: Paper §2.1 stores daily conversations, daily event summaries, global summary, daily personality, global personality. Code memory_bank/summarize_memory.py summarize_memory writes summary, personality, overall_history, overall_personality per user. No character vs user vs relationship tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Every dialog turn is logged into memory storage (paper §3 Integration with MemoryBank). Summaries and portraits are LLM-generated offline in summarize_memory.py. No refusal of jokes or hypotheticals. Forgetting is probabilistic, not a user pin.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Current utterance is the FAISS query. Dual-tower dense retrieval of turns and event summaries (paper §2.2). local_doc_qa / LocalMemoryRetrieval.search_memory returns top_k=6 chunks (VECTOR_SEARCH_TOP_K). Prompt concatenates retrieved memory, global user portrait, and global event summary. No explicit retrieve-nothing gate.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: New days add new history keys. Summaries overwrite the date slot when regenerated. No delete-on-contradiction. Conflicting facts can both sit in FAISS.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: History is dated YYYY-MM-DD. Retrieval strings include Conversation content on {date}. forgetting_curve uses day deltas from last_recall_date (forget_memory.py). No last-Tuesday query language.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One JSON object per user_name. AI is boot_name. Personality is of the user only. Character identity is the SiliconFriend prompt plus LoRA, not a store type.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Top-k FAISS always injects similar chunks. No trauma or spoiler controls in paper or forget_memory.py.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Stored dialog text is retrieved verbatim into the companion prompt. No provenance or trust tags.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: forget_memory.py forgetting_curve(t, S)=math.exp(-t / 5*S). MemoryForgetterLoader.initial_load_forget_and_save drops turns when random() > retention_probability. Recalled items increment memory_strength and reset last_recall_date (update_memory_when_searched). Paper §2.3 models Ebbinghaus R=e^{-t/S}. No user forget-that command.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Online turn. one embedding of the query plus FAISS top-k, then the companion LLM. Summaries and portraits are extra LLM calls per date in summarize_memory.py. Paper does not publish per-turn token budgets.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: MIT LICENSE. Open ChatGLM/BELLE paths plus local MiniLM/Text2vec and FAISS. ChatGPT variant needs OpenAI. Repo last pushed 2023-05-24. Requires those models, not a vendor memory API.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: 2023 research repo. No MCP server in the tree.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Classic companion paper. Stores user history, event summary, and user portrait, then stuffs retrieved text into the prompt. Forgetting curve is real. One user bag. No character or relationship types. Eval is 194 memory probes on 10-day simulated chats, not social silence or identity drift.

published_eval.name: Authors' 194 probing questions on 10-day / 15-user simulated companion chats
published_eval.claimed_score: English SiliconFriend ChatGPT retrieval acc 0.763, correctness 0.716, coherence 0.912 (Table 2). ChatGLM retrieval 0.809 but correctness 0.438.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether retrieved memory and the reply contain the fact asked in a later probe. Human labels on retrieval, correctness, coherence. Not character drift, silence, poisoning, or forget-that.

open_unknowns: Whether the released LoRA checkpoints still load on current ChatGLM/BELLE stacks.
Exact VECTOR_SEARCH_TOP_K used in the paper experiments versus the code default 6.
